reference.description: Owner-supplied Cyrene conditioning reference; already tracked in the repository before this task

missing_data_request: 20-60 minutes total of clean, varied, single-speaker English Cyrene speech authorized for adaptation; the known reference contributes only 0.259 minutes.
At least five independent source groups/sessions for an 80/10/10 source-group split, or a separate independent validation/test set; one recording cannot make train and test independent.
Human-reviewed transcripts for every selected utterance, with exact spoken words and no invented persona lines.
Recorded permission basis and provenance for each source; no scraped, generated, or third-party voice audio.
Coverage of neutral, gentle, playful, reflective, question, name, number and punctuation deliveries; avoid a single breathy line as the only sample.
Reject music-heavy, multi-speaker, clipped or overlapping material; process to 24 kHz mono PCM without aggressive denoising or speed/pitch changes.
